name: Nanase Yuu
source:
Yuu lives in Hiroshima (広島), Hiroshima and goes to Akenomiya High School (朱之宮高校) where she is a third year student in class B.

She likes traveling, stargazing, and the subjects she likes in school are geography and astronomy.

Her voice is done by Nishiguchi Yuka (西口有香).
